# Setting Up Social Preview Image 🖼️

To complete the repository setup, please add the social preview image manually:

## Steps to Add Social Preview

1. Go to repository settings: https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/settings
2. Scroll down to the "Social preview" section
3. Click "Edit" or "Upload an image"
4. Upload the `assets/img/og.png` file (1200x630px)
5. Click "Save"

## Image Details

- **File:** `assets/img/og.png`
- **Dimensions:** 1200 x 630 pixels
- **Format:** PNG
- **Size:** ~646 KB

This will make your repository look beautiful when shared on social media, Slack, Discord, etc.!

---

**Note:** GitHub doesn't provide an API endpoint to set social preview images automatically. This must be done through the web interface.
